description.$value: Link colors of the brand mode CH_app. The plain names are for light surfaces, the names with _inverse for dark surfaces. The link tokens point here, so the brand decides the link colors.

default.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, default, light surfaces. CH_app: interaction color.

default_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, default, dark surfaces. CH_app: interaction color.

hover.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, hover, light surfaces. CH_app: interaction color.

hover_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, hover, dark surfaces. CH_app: interaction color.

active.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, active, light surfaces. CH_app: interaction color.

active_inverse.$description: Role: Exclusive. Link color, active, dark surfaces. CH_app: interaction color.
